messages.subject: logistic Gaussian process regression model
parts:
Hi All,

Does anyone know if it is possible to fit a "logistic Gaussian process regression model" with INLA? 

The model can be found in the below link: 

https://mc-stan.org/docs/2_19/stan-users-guide/fit-gp-section.html

It's simply works by replacing linear predictors with a GP to make Logistic regression non-linear. It's computationally hard to fit it using MCMC so I am wondering if it's possible to fit it using INLA. Any help would be appreciated.
